description: This Java source file defines the class 'XmlWidgetActionVisitor', which generates XML representations of widget model actions within the Apache OFBiz framework. It implements methods to visit various widget actions and serialize them into XML format, supporting extensibility for different widget actions such as services, property maps, entity conditions, and related entities.

classes.name: XmlWidgetActionVisitor
classes.description: A class that traverses widget model actions and outputs their XML representation. It extends 'XmlAbstractWidgetVisitor' and implements 'ModelActionVisitor' to handle various widget actions such as entity conditions, related entities, property maps, scripts, services, and field settings.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Overloaded methods to generate XML for different widget actions like 'CallParentActions', 'EntityAnd', 'EntityCondition', 'EntityOne', 'GetRelated', 'GetRelatedOne', 'PropertyMap', 'PropertyToField', 'Script', 'Service', and 'SetField'. Each method writes corresponding XML elements and attributes.
